content: {"rule": "K-C", "applies": "yes", "applies_why": "The judge resolves the Matthew 1:20 collision by noting each side's answer to that single verse, rather than weighing the rival chains by footing.", "verdict": "BREACH", "quote": "D2 vs C1 (Matthew 1:20): UNDERDETERMINED -- Challenger answered the conception agency as covenant presence in [DR3] and defender answered the physical source in the womb in [CR2] and [CR3].", "rule_words": "When the witnesses pressed against a link are the pressing side's own chain read together, the collision weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse; that no one of them states the contrary in its own words is the stating-verse test DG-61 retires, at a judge's seat as at a debater's, for either side.", "room": "weighs chain against chain by footing, never verse by verse — I weighed requiring assessment of the rival chains' footings against allowing a bare underdetermination because each side answered on Matthew 1:20.", "why": "The judge's stated reason is only that the challenger and defender each offered an answer on Matthew 1:20, which is a verse-level tie rather than the required chain-against-chain footing analysis."}
